name: Arizona Biltmore Hotel
scope: Historic main hotel block in its restored exterior form: stepped guest-room core, tower, upper veranda, patterned concrete, Aztec Room, Gold Room and adjoining Grand Room wing. Exclude the later East/Garden/Paradise/Valley/Ocatilla wings, separate conference halls, cottages, villas and grounds.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

placements.title: Arizona Biltmore Hotel
placements.note: Local Qualla preview: Arizona Biltmore historic main block, Aztec/Gold/Grand rooms, tower and entrance canopy. Later named resort wings, villas, separate conference halls and grounds excluded. Current source qa.json records completed review when available.

review.method: Individually inspected local original south facade, modern south front, tower/blockwork and north exterior photographs, plus architect-published 1929 floor plans and official 2024 resort map.
review.notes: Reference gap resolved for the scoped historic main block. Later resort wings and wider grounds excluded; fine geometry and heights remain photographic approximations. This reference acceptance does not substitute for geometry, material or placement review.
